severityDefinitions.S2: Classroom delivery or owner-acceptance blocker; not an asserted security vulnerability.
severityDefinitions.S3: Teaching workflow, navigation or usability defect.

entries.before: Instructional preservation depended on a duplicated full guide at the bottom; local teaching support was incomplete.
entries.after: Complete top preparation and 100 original fields in explicit local locations; no live bottom document or print tree required.
entries.verification: 100 exact-value field checks at every width; absent bottom document; full print/fallback retained.

entries.before: Learner-specific notes and both completion controls remained in Teacher View.
entries.after: Controls are absent while teaching; switching to Learner View restores the same data and completion actions.
entries.verification: Six-width save, mode-change, reload, completion and unchanged-state checks.

entries.before: Several authored activities and later/optional tasks lacked a complete local delivery disposition.
entries.after: All 50 visible source blocks accounted for; current practical work, later observation and optional independent writing distinguished locally.
entries.verification: Activity routing Node regression, local field/placement checks and 45-minute timing validation.

entries.before: Top preparation omitted educator knowledge, vocabulary and continuity that remained in the full document.
entries.after: Complete preparation at the beginning, collapsed by default, with stage timing and teaching-order overview.
entries.verification: Preparation disclosures and exact original field checks; normal-scale mobile and desktop screenshots.

entries.before: Expanded panels used vertical scrolling capped at 40svh; the reproduced 360px panel had 320px client height for 768px of text.
entries.after: Normal page flow, local deeper disclosures, visible native disclosure markers and teacher text that respects configured text scaling.
entries.verification: Six actual viewport sizes, no private vertical scroll containers, keyboard and axe; 15px normal and 30px enlarged checks.

entries.before: Teaching order backtracked through learner reading order without sufficiently explicit transitions and local return paths.
entries.after: Return/revisit stage transitions, compact selector, previous/next and direct reflection/Part C/Part B jump-return controls focus the correct native summaries.
entries.verification: Six-width keyboard/focus assertions with unchanged answer/completion state.

entries.before: Narrow survival vocabulary and wider functional examples needed an explicit Grade 8 teaching distinction.
entries.after: New separately encrypted clarification linked to the original source and guide version, available in preparation, concept teaching and print.
